content: Bithumb REST rate limits reported (2023 update, unverified currency): public ~135 req/s, private raised from 15 to 140 req/s; order create/cancel capped ~10 req/s; WS connection limit 10/sec/IP (post-connect stream messages not counted). Confirms per-channel (not global) limiting structure but exact numbers must be reverified at apidocs.bithumb.com/docs/rate_limits at build time.
